title: Video Doorbell vs Security Camera: Which One Does Your Home Need?
summary: Trying to decide between a video doorbell and a security camera? Here's how to choose.
body_markdown:
Looking for a way to secure your front door without spending a ton of money? The Arlo Video Doorbell has you covered.


Our best-in-class wireless video doorbell includes a number of features that you can access, right out of the box. You’ll get crystal clear 2K video, a wide 180° Field of View, and Night Vision so you can see everything that approaches your porch. Plus, built-in 2-Way Audio makes it easy to talk with anyone who arrives, making it easy to notify guests or direct package deliveries whether you’re at home, at work, or on vacation.


Pair your new Arlo Video Doorbell with[Arlo Smart Aware](https://us.arlo.com/pages/arlo-secure) , and get even more out of our award-winning security system. The Early Warning System leverages powerful AI algorithms to detect and instantly alert you about suspicious activity. Smart Activity Zones allow you to cover the most important areas in your feed. 60-Day Video History gives you instant access to your archives. And with Arlo Smart Secure, you’ll even get 24/7 Professional Monitoring and 24/7 Emergency Response, adding a human touch to automated security.


Discover the Arlo difference.[Pick up an Arlo Video Doorbell today](https://us.arlo.com/products/arlo-doorbell) , and you’ll enjoy a free 30-day trial of Arlo Smart Secure.
